name: pcrep-ero-roundtrip
source: built by tools/gen/ietf-more-vectors.py from values chosen there; layout restated from RFC 5440 sections 6 and 7 and RFC 3209 section 4.3.3; a PCRep: RP, an ERO of two strict IPv4 hops, a loose AS hop and a subobject of type 3 kept as octets, and a METRIC bound of 30; expect derived there, no engine run
